'''Droman''' was an [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rhamalai]]. [[Gender/Legends|He]] told [[General/Legends|General]] [[Naem Yrros|Yrros]] that it wasn't standard procedure for a general to address new conscripts, but Yrros responded that he sets the precedent. He then had Droman explain to [[Denel Moonrunner]] what his identification number stood for.
